title: IMPELLOR COMPRESSOR SHAFT
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.TROOP SUPPORT INDUSTRIAL HARDWARE.DLA TROOP SUPPORT
detail_text: DLA Troop Support Philadelphia anticipates issuing a definite quantity contract for a quantity of 20 each with a 75% Option Quantity. The requirement is for an Impeller, Compressor Shaft NSN 4130-01-469-6271. This NSN is manufactured by Johnson Controls Navy Systems LLC (66935) under part numbers 364-48543-000 and 377-15863-001. The solicitation will be issued using FAR 15. The anticipated solicitation date is May 1, 2026. For inquiries please contact Jennifer Luczkowski at Jennifer.Luczkowski@dla.mil
